Funny you should mention Igo...I've met the guy who was the model for him.
His name is Keith Slade and he lives in Rhode Island (as does Ed Beard, the
artist). Traded Magic cards with him, too. :)
I also met the guy who was the model for Lazarus, a student of Beard's named
Ron Rousselle who might have some artwork in a future Magic expansion. I
think there's also a card that Beard himself was the model for, but I'm not
sure which one it is since I don't have the card (it's got a picture of a
bearded guy holding a cup over a table, I believe).
